name: Human
title: HUMAN — Versatile and Determined
cardBlurb: Who are your ancestors? What languages do they speak?
flavour: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious of the common species. Their short lives drive them to achieve as much as they can — and the Sword Coast remembers those who try.
speedNote: Your movement speed. Sprint with Shift to move much faster on foot.

pointBuy.note: Your Soldier background determines your primary ability increases.

abilityGuidance.STR: Melee attacks hit harder; force open stuck doors and win grapples.
abilityGuidance.DEX: Move quietly, react quickly, and strike true with bows and light blades.
abilityGuidance.CON: More health and grit — shrug off poison, cold, and long marches.
abilityGuidance.INT: Recall lore, solve riddles, and notice what others overlook in books and ruins.
abilityGuidance.WIS: Spot ambushes, read people, and survive the wilds between towns.
abilityGuidance.CHA: Bargain, persuade, and stare down trouble before steel is drawn.

recommendedBuild.rationale: Balanced frontline warrior. High Strength for melee, good Constitution for health, decent Wisdom for spotting ambushes.

languages.recommendReason: Useful for understanding the enemies you'll face early on.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.pitch: Start each day with 1 Inspiration charge. Spend it to reroll any d20 check — a glowing star in your HUD.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.pitch: Proficiency in one additional skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.pitch: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.
